name: 侠客新传98书剑
english_name: New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman: '98 Edition
english_description: "New Legend of the Wandering Swordsman" v0.1b, MudOS v22pre11, by the Xkxz MUD Wizard Group, 2000-2001, maintained by jjgod. Despite carrying "Book and Sword" in its Chinese title, it shares no lineage with this project's actual Book and Sword series (sjecl/sje/sjplgfjxb/sjplii) — the resemblance is purely coincidental naming, likely a site version codename from that year. It is also unrelated to the other "XKX"/Xiake-titled MUDs (xkx100/xkx2017) despite the similar name; a byte-for-byte comparison of master.lpc instead places it in the "hell / Doing Lu" lineage (ES II to XKX to hell), sharing ancestry with zjdyaryl, zjdyzj, and hell. Its map notably includes a Miao borderlands region with Gu-sorcery culture and sect settings, a relatively uncommon backdrop among these archives.
